description: Validate VAST, VMAP and DAAST ad tags against IAB specifications, including SIMID and OMID checks. The public tools validate_vast, validate_vast_url, inspect_vast, list_rules, explain_rule and fix_vast require no login. Connect directly to https://vastlint.org/mcp. AdCP content-standards tools require Bearer authentication. Hosted submissions may be stored with identifiers stripped to improve validation rules; see https://vastlint.org/privacy/. Local vastlint-mcp over stdio keeps tags on your machine. Built on the open-source Rust validation core. Apache-2.0 licensed.
